plugins.description: A private, local-first companion that gets to know one person over time and reads their life through four lenses: real 八字 BaZi / Western natal / 紫微斗数 charts and 合婚, a daily reading woven with their own journal, RIASEC career fit scored against real O*NET occupation data, and relationship reflection grounded in what actually happened rather than in memory. The computation is reproducible fact; every interpretation is labeled a mirror and never a forecast — and that line is enforced by an honesty gate in code, not merely asked for. Consent is per category and enforced at the write, everything stays on the machine, deletion really deletes, and a crisis drops the fortune-telling for real, localized help.
